mo_brief.title: MAJOR ORDER
mo_brief.original: Uphold election security by destroying all those who would threaten it.
mo_brief.translated: 维护选举安全，摧毁一切胆敢威胁它的人。

items.original:
ARSENAL AUGMENTATION

Funds from the Super Secure Elections Act have been allocated to support Helldiver operations on ROGUE 5 with the Anti-Personnel Mine Deployer Stratagem for the next 24 hours.
items.translated:
军械扩充

《超级安全选举法》拨出的资金已获分配，将在未来24小时内以“反步兵地雷部署器”战略配备支援绝地潜兵在罗格5的行动。

items.original:
NEW MAJOR ORDER

The Super Earth Government, informed by the results of an expert election security panel, has passed a comprehensive Super Secure Elections Act, which allocates new military spending for upholding election security.

Helldiver arsenals have been augmented with a number of stratagems. They are directed to uphold election security—by any means necessary.
items.translated:
新重要指令

超级地球政府在听取了选举安全专家小组的结论后，已通过一部全面的《超级安全选举法》，该法案拨出新的军费以维护选举安全。

绝地潜兵的军械库已获得多项战略配备的增强。他们奉命维护选举安全——以任何必要手段。
